about: Chestermere is a city on a reservoir lake immediately east of Calgary in Alberta. It grew from a summer cottage shoreline into a full suburban city wrapped around Chestermere Lake, with waterfront paths, new neighbourhoods, and easy access to the Trans-Canada Highway. About 22,000 people live in Chestermere.
